propositions: The enrich drain holds its advisory lock across NO-TIMEOUT LLM calls (437s–131s observed), blocking concurrent drains and limiting throughput to ~5 items per multi-minute hold with a standing backlog of ~1,046 entries.

The drain must be restructured into three phases (collect under lock, enrich without lock, finalize without lock) to release the lock before LLM calls, enabling concurrent drainers and reducing per-item lock cost from 87.4s to 9.8s.

Concurrent drains must be bounded (max 3 distinct live-lease drainers) via a concurrency guard in the collect phase, with a lease-derived batch clamp (lease_ttl_s // 40, ~20–25 items) to prevent lease expiry mid-run.

Stale-at-writeback tickets must be revalidated in finalize by comparing content-hash snapshots; if stale, the emit is skipped and the entry is re-enqueued with soak 0 (immediate retry) as stale_skipped.

The restructure must preserve behavior for store write locks, queue event schema, has_pending_enrichment semantics, MCP surface, and per-write spawned drain children become productive concurrent drainers.
